title: The Cool of Evening
blurb: A cheap bus dies at noon on an empty desert road, hours from anywhere. A child travelling alone is failing in the heat, and no help will come until the sun drops. You have the long afternoon to keep them — and a busload of strangers — watered, shaded and alive.

identity.name: High Noon
identity.mood: A desert road at the hottest hour; the only mercy is the water and shade people share.

line.en: The bus dies in the heat. A child aboard needs the water and shade you can find.
line.fr: Le bus tombe en panne dans la chaleur. À bord, un enfant a besoin de l'eau et de l'ombre que vous trouverez.
line.es: El autobús se avería con el calor. A bordo, un niño necesita el agua y la sombra que puedas encontrar.
line.it: L'autobus si ferma nella calura. A bordo, un bambino ha bisogno dell'acqua e dell'ombra che riuscirai a trovare.
line.de: Der Bus bleibt in der Hitze liegen. An Bord braucht ein Kind das Wasser und den Schatten, die du findest.
line.pt: O autocarro avaria no calor. A bordo, uma criança precisa da água e da sombra que conseguires encontrar.
line.ru: Автобус глохнет на жаре. В салоне ребёнку нужны вода и тень, которые ты сможешь найти.
line.zh: 大巴在烈日下抛锚了。车上有个孩子，需要你去找来的水和阴凉。
line.ar: تتعطّل الحافلة في الحرّ. على متنها طفل يحتاج إلى ما تجده من ماءٍ وظلّ.

hero.sub: A story where you are the hero — and every choice turns you to a new page. Written for people learning English, at your level, with meaning in your language whenever you need it.
